verdict.reasons: The core product (AFP drip-tape carton) is accurately identified, fully visible, and correctly scaled within the agronomic setting. The authorized watermark and sleeve captions are legible and consistent. Minor advisory issues include the coiled tape segment on the soil, which slightly deviates from standard lateral deployment, but it does not compromise the product identity or the article's intent. The neutral seedlings and irrigation context are well-integrated.

focused_physical_review.reason: While the irrigation lines do not physically cross the white and blue AFP package, the clear_soil_gap condition is failed because a distinct, uninstalled coiled section of black drip tape sits directly adjacent to the right of the package. This extra uninstalled coil prevents a broad uninterrupted soil gap from being visible around the complete footprint of the package. No protruding strips or tails are visible emerging from the sides or base of the carton.

acceptance_warnings: Independent physical condition not met: clear_soil_gap
Independent physical condition not met: extra_loose_product_coil
